description: §22.4.1 / §22.12 (S458 "your recs on all four", item 3) positive — only `data-scrml` itself and the `data-scrml-` prefix are compiler-owned. Ordinary `data-*` attributes and near-miss names pass in compile-time `emit()` output (`data-x`, `data-scrmlx`, `x-data-scrml-y`) and in runtime `meta.emit` output (`data-k`), and both reach the rendered DOM.
rationale: §22.4.1: the refusal is "a prefix over the attribute name" `data-scrml-`; every other attribute name is judged as before.
